title: How to Show Affirmations in iPhone StandBy Mode
description: Step-by-step guide to putting a daily affirmation on your iPhone StandBy screen (iOS 17/18): enable StandBy, add the small Anicca widget, and keep it readable while charging.
markdown:
# How to Show Affirmations in iPhone StandBy Mode

Set your iPhone on a stand while it charges and the screen turns into StandBy: a clock, photos, and widgets you can read from across the room. Putting one short affirmation there means the first line you read in the morning, or the last one before bed, is a sentence you chose. This guide takes about two minutes.

## What you need

- An iPhone on iOS 17 or later. StandBy arrived in iOS 17; there is no StandBy on iOS 16 or earlier.
- The Anicca app, installed and opened once so the widget has an affirmation to show.
- A charger: StandBy appears while the iPhone is charging.

## Step by step

1. **Turn StandBy on.** Open Settings, then StandBy, and check that it is enabled (it is on by default on iOS 17 and later).
2. **Open Anicca once.** Answer the short questions so the app picks your first affirmation. The widget shows the same words the app chose for you.
3. **Put the iPhone on a charger and turn it sideways.** With the screen locked in landscape, StandBy appears after a moment.
4. **Swipe to the widgets screen,** then touch and hold the widget area.
5. **Tap the "+" button,** search for "Anicca", and pick the **Small** size. StandBy shows the small widget and iOS enlarges it to fill the screen, so the size you already use on the Home Screen is the same widget here.
6. **Tap "Add Widget"** and place it where you want it. StandBy shows two widgets side by side; swipe to move between pages.

## Good to know

- **Night mode.** In a dark room StandBy dims to a red tint so the screen stays quiet. Your affirmation remains readable.
- **No extra setup.** The small widget Anicca already builds for the Home Screen is the one StandBy displays; there is nothing separate to switch on in the app.
- **Keep the words short.** One sentence you believe reads better than a paragraph you skip. The small size fits a short line; the medium size is for the Home Screen.
- **Want it before you unlock?** See [How to Put an Affirmation on Your iPhone Lock Screen](https://aniccaai.com/lock-screen-affirmation-widget-iphone). For the Home Screen, see [How to Add an Affirmation Widget to Your iPhone Home Screen](https://aniccaai.com/home-screen-affirmation-widget-iphone).

## Troubleshooting

- **Nothing appears on the charger:** check that StandBy is enabled in Settings, that the iPhone is locked and in landscape, and that the charger is connected.
- **Anicca is missing from the widget list:** open the app once, update it from the App Store, and try again.
- **The widget is blank:** open Anicca once and give iOS a minute; widgets refresh on the system's own schedule.

## Try it

Anicca is a free download with a 3-day trial for the full set of affirmations and reminders.

[Download Anicca on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6755129214?ct=seo-standby-howto)
